subject: POC Kickoff — sample payload sharing & calendar options
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Nima Shah <nima@orionai.com>, Priya Rao <priya@orionai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: POC Kickoff — sample payload sharing & calendar options

Hi Nima / Priya —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. We’re excited to get the POC kickoff scheduled and run through a short hands-on session focused on prompt review, routing behavior, and a couple of light load tests to validate throughput and latency at your target QPS.

Proposed kickoff structure (90–120 min):
- 15m intros + goals alignment
- 30m prompt review & routing mapping (we’ll look at a few canonical prompt variants)
- 30m running small load tests with your sample payloads
- 15–30m next steps: redlines, rollout plan, checklist

Calendar options (PST):
- Tue 2026-02-24 09:30–11:00
- Wed 2026-02-25 13:00–14:30
- Thu 2026-02-26 10:00–11:30

Action items for Orion before the session:
1) Share a representative sample of ~200–500 prompts/payloads (CSV or JSONL). If there are PII fields, please follow the attached redaction_guidelines.md — redaction for PII is fine, but keep realism for tokens (don’t truncate midsentence).
2) Mark an evaluation set (50–100 examples) you care most about for quality checks.
3) If you have any routing rules or expected model fallbacks, drop a short list in the Drive link below.

I attached a short agenda (poc-agenda-v2.pdf) and our redaction guidance. Monica and Karthik are on copy and will run the hands-on portion.

If those times don’t work, tell us two windows that do and we’ll adapt.

Thanks —
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: poc-agenda-v2.pdf, redaction_guidelines.md
From: Nima Shah <nima@orionai.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@orionai.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff — sample payload sharing & calendar options

Rafael —

Appreciate the clear agenda. Wed 2/25 13:00–14:30 PST looks best for us, but we need a slight shift: can we move it to 14:00–15:30 instead? We have a conflicting customer all-hands until 1:30.

We’ll prepare a sample manifest and start a redacted export. Attached is an initial CSV outline (orion_sample_manifest.csv) showing fields and counts — this is from our data team, it’s redacted at a column level for now. A few clarifications:

- For the load test, what QPS should we expect you to run against our sample set?
- For routing, we have a simple intent tag in payloads; we’ll include an example mapping.
- Can you confirm you’ll preserve tokenization realism when we redact? Our concern is that truncation will change latency and model behavior.

Also looping in Priya to confirm the attendee list — we’ll likely bring one engineer and one product manager.

Thanks,
Nima Shah
Head of Product | Orion AI
nima@orionai.com

Attachments: orion_sample_manifest.csv
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Nima Shah <nima@orionai.com>, Priya Rao <priya@orionai.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff — sample payload sharing & calendar options

Nima — great, 2/25 14:00–15:30 PST works for us. I’ll send a calendar invite shortly.

Answers to your clarifications:
- Load test target: start with a smoke run at ~5 QPS (burst-capable), then a sustained run at 1–2 QPS for 5 minutes, and a final 30s burst to 20 QPS to observe tail latency. We’ll only do what you’re comfortable with — confirm if those numbers are safe for your environment.
- Routing: perfect — include the intent tag and one example mapping; we’ll replicate that routing in the session and show fallback behavior if a route is unavailable.
- Redaction/tokenization: that’s exactly what our redaction_guidelines.md is for. We recommend replacing PII with same-length tokens where possible (e.g., replace email@domain.com -> user@example.com, same token count). Monica will validate token-length parity during ingestion.

Monica / Karthik — can you prep the small load harness and the short set of demo prompts (I recommend 20 canonical prompts + 50 eval examples from Orion’s manifest) before Wed? We’ll provision a temporary endpoint under Rafael-RD-5628 for the session.

Next: I’ve created a Drive folder (link below) where Orion can drop the redacted sample and the eval set. Priya, once you confirm attendees I’ll add them to the folder.

— Rafael

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-orion-poc
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Nima Shah <nima@orionai.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-23T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff — sample payload sharing & calendar options

Thanks — confirming a few operational details ahead of Wed 2/25 14:00–15:30 PST.

Quick checklist for Orion to drop in the Drive folder before 10:00 PST on Wed: 
- redacted_sample.jsonl (200–300 records, same token length where possible)
- eval_set.jsonl (50 records labeled prioritized)
- routing_map.csv (intent -> route)

Monica notes on prompt review: we’ll run a short prompt-variant diff (20 prompts) to show how small wording changes affect routing and token counts. Please include any system/instruction templates you use. We’ll also record the session and provide the logs and a short latency/cost snapshot after the run.

If you have compliance questions about the redaction approach, we can run the files through our redaction script together on the call to demonstrate the transformation.

Looking forward — I’ll be the session lead for the hands-on portion.

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com
